title: Humble Heart
story:
A successful CEO visited his company’s office early one morning.

Before anyone arrived, he noticed the floor was dirty.

Chairs were not arranged.

Trash was left behind.

He could have ignored it.

He could have waited for the cleaning staff.

Instead, he quietly picked up a broom.

He cleaned the floor.

He arranged the chairs.

He made everything ready.

Soon, the employees arrived.

They were surprised.

“Why did you do this?” one asked.

The CEO smiled.

“No work is beneath me,” he said.

“I am here to serve, not just to lead.”

In life, we often seek position.

Recognition.

Status.

But Jesus showed a different way.

Though He was God,

He humbled Himself.

He became a servant.

He gave His life for others.

True greatness is not in being above others.

It is in serving them.

When we follow His example,

we reflect His heart.
life_lesson:
True greatness comes through humility and service.

Follow the example of Christ by putting others before yourself.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for the example of Jesus.

Help me to have a humble heart.

Teach me to serve others selflessly.

Remove pride from my life.

Help me to reflect Christ in my actions.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Do you seek recognition or do you seek to serve?

Are there areas where pride is holding you back?

How can you show humility in your daily life today?
verse:
In your relationships with one another, have the same mindset as Christ Jesus.
Who, being in very nature God, did not consider equality with God something to be used to His own advantage.
Rather, He made Himself nothing by taking the very nature of a servant.
Being made in human likeness.
And being found in appearance as a man, He humbled Himself by becoming obedient to death, even death on a cross.
